summary: Verified new Scene 13 'Cost Recovery and Asset Intelligence' in Supermarket demo. Start screen correctly shows 'Run the 15-scene', '15 cinematic scenes', story arc lists 15 items with 'Cost Recovery + Asset Intelligence' at position 13. Scene 1 header reads 'Scene 1 of 15'. Auto-advance from scene 1 → 2 confirmed. Reached Scene 13 programmatically (via audio-ended fast-advance) and verified data-testid='stage-cost-recovery' renders ALL 6 flag cards (Repeated service calls, Maintenance cost climbing, End-of-life equipment, Lighting upgrade opportunity, Refrigeration efficiency, Vendor overcharging detected), ALL 5 Reactive-vs-Proactive rows (Trigger/Decision/Vendor/Energy/Outcome), ALL 6 financial-impact tiles (Estimated cost savings, Avoided repair spend, Reduced energy usage, Vendor overcharge recovered, ROI on upgrades, Avoided downtime sales loss) and recommended ACTIONs (REPLACE, ESCALATE, CAPITAL) on flag cards. Scenes 14 (stage-financial-impact) and 15 (stage-closing) also reach and render. StageImage strip visible on Scene 13. TTS /api/tts/speak returns 200 audio/mpeg (221KB) for the new cost-recovery narration. All 5 demos (/demo/realtor, /demo/insurance, /demo/creator, /demo/noldus, /demo/supermarket) load with 0 console errors and show an image element after Start. Lint clean on SupermarketDemoPage.jsx and images.js. Two blocking missing-icon bugs fixed (Crown, Workflow) — see updated_files.
action_items: HIGH (FIXED by testing agent): /app/frontend/src/pages/SupermarketDemoPage.jsx was using `Crown` and `Workflow` lucide-react icons inside ExecutiveViewStage (Scene 8) but neither was added to the lucide-react import list. This threw `ReferenceError: Crown is not defined` (and then Workflow) at runtime when the demo auto-advanced to Scene 8, triggering the ErrorBoundary and blocking Scenes 8–15 — including the new Scene 13. Without the fix, a real user who clicked Start would never reach the new Cost Recovery scene. Fix applied: added `Crown, Workflow` to the import list on line 13. Main agent should code-review and keep this fix; consider a lightweight test that imports every icon referenced in a stage to prevent regressions.
Consider splitting SupermarketDemoPage.jsx (now 1518 lines) into /pages/supermarket/scenes/*.jsx — carried over from iter-17/18, still applicable after the new scene added more length.
critical_code_review_comments: Missing icon imports (Crown, Workflow) silently passed lint because ESLint treats JSX-only identifiers via react/jsx-no-undef, which was evidently not failing here — add eslint-plugin-react with jsx-no-undef enabled, or centralize icon imports via a barrel file so missing icons are caught at build time.

SCENES array is 1517-line file's main data. Extracting SCENES (+ narration strings) to /lib/supermarket-scenes.js and the 15 stage components to their own files will cut churn risk on future scene inserts.

ErrorBoundary shows 'Reload page' but scene auto-advance logic still marches forward in state even after a throw — consider freezing scene progression once ErrorBoundary catches so users aren't stranded on a broken scene silently.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/SupermarketDemoPage.jsx (added `Crown, Workflow` to lucide-react import list on line 13 to fix ReferenceError in ExecutiveViewStage that was blocking all scenes 8–15 including the new Cost Recovery scene 13)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-19 verified the new Scene 13 Cost Recovery + Asset Intelligence end-to-end. Required two small icon-import fixes in SupermarketDemoPage.jsx (Crown, Workflow) to unblock Scene 8 onwards — those were pre-existing latent bugs that only surfaced once auto-advance reached Scene 8; they are now fixed. Scene 13 renders all 6 flags + 5 comparison rows + 6 impact tiles + recommended actions, and stage-image strip is visible. Scenes 14/15 intact. TTS works for new narration. All 5 demo pages load cleanly. If the main agent modifies stage components or icons again, re-run a quick fast-advance test (mute + dispatch 'ended' on audio elements) to confirm all 15 scenes mount without ReferenceErrors.
rca of the issue: RCA (Crown/Workflow undefined): ExecutiveViewStage (scene 8) references <Crown /> and <Workflow /> lucide-react icons via `Icon: Crown` and `Icon: Workflow` props. The top-of-file `import { ... } from 'lucide-react'` listed ArrowRight, Sparkles, DollarSign, Lightbulb, RefreshCcw, Snowflake etc. but omitted both Crown and Workflow. Because these identifiers were only referenced inside the ExecutiveViewStage JSX, the bug was not reproducible on initial page load (scene 1) and only surfaced when the demo auto-advanced to scene 8 — which is why previous iterations (that manually inspected early scenes or the start screen) did not catch it. The ErrorBoundary swallowed the render and replaced the whole scene area with 'We couldn't render this page. Crown is not defined', silently blocking scenes 8–15 (including the new scene 13). Mitigation applied: added `Crown, Workflow` to the lucide-react import list. Long-term mitigation: enable eslint-plugin-react `jsx-no-undef` rule and centralize icon imports in a barrel module.
